descriptionByLocale.en: The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world. We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all. Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams. Why Join Us? • Innovation At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom. • Flexibility & Global Reach We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground. • Fast-Paced & Impactful Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future. • A Team that Thrives on Collaboration We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities. • Grow with the Best At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry. If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home. We’re looking for: HR People Operations Specialist The Role We’re currently looking for an HR People Operations Specialist to join our remote-first, globally distributed team. In this role, you will help build and run the operational backbone of our People function—coordinating day-to-day HR processes, maintaining accurate records, supporting onboarding and offboarding, and ensuring smooth collaboration between HR, Finance, and leadership. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys structure, is comfortable with systems and data, and cares deeply about creating a seamless experience for our team members around the world. What You Bring to the Table • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, comfortable in a fully remote, asynchronous environment • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail—able to manage multiple processes and follow-ups at once • At least 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, people & engagement, or project coordination (or a combination of these) • Experience working with HR systems, spreadsheets, and collaborative tools • Good understanding of core HR processes, policies and standards (onboarding/offboarding, records management, time-off tracking, basic compliance) • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with HR and operational data • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain HR processes clearly to non-HR colleagues • A people-centred approach: you are approachable, empathetic, and comfortable being a visible, go-to contact for HR questions and support • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate with managers and team members across functions and locations • A proactive, solution-oriented approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment • Discretion, reliability, and a strong focus on security and privacy in handling personal data • Curiosity about crypto, fintech, or technology-driven organizations is a plus. What We Offer: • Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture • Mentorship & Growth • Competitive Pay • Career Development Opportunities • Supportive Team Environment • Learning & Knowledge Sharing • Team-Building Activities • Social activities (online & in-person) Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all? If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you! Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose. All assessments and recruitment-related communications are conducted exclusively through official Bitfinex email addresses (e.g., firstname.lastname@bitfinex.com ). Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means. As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent . All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable. Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process. If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com . Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed . Equal Opportunity Statement At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Beschreibung von The Original Bitcoin Exchange basiert auf der Vision von Bitcoin in der freien Finanzwelt und bietet allen Menschen die Möglichkeit, Transaktionen durchzuführen und sich ohne Probleme in der ganzen Welt zu verbinden. Nach den ersten Schritten der Bitcoin-Entwicklung ist unsere Mission der Grund, die Freiheit zu fördern, indem sie eine innovative, zuverlässige und zugängliche Technologie vertritt, die alles garantiert, jedes Jahr, aber nur wenige Instrumente für die Teilnahme an einer Welt, die wahrheitsgemäss und ohne Einschränkungen ist. Siamo leitet eine unaufhörliche Innovation und Emanzipation im Finanzwesen. Da die gesamte Bildung Vorrang hat und eine allgemeine Schulungsmaßnahme erforderlich ist, können Sie nur bestimmte Erwerbsutensilien verwenden, digitale Vermögenswerte in sicherer Form und ohne Probleme aufbewahren und betrügen. Während sich das digitale Asset-Panorama rasant entwickelt, die gesamte Avantgarde abbaut, bieten wir Dienstleistungen für den Allavantgarde-Handel an, die dann für Einzelpersonen und globale Liquiditätsgeber nützlich sein können. Unser Ansatz ist einfach und flexibel, um sicherzustellen, dass die Finanzfreiheit nicht allein eine Vision ist, sondern eine Realität für Sie. Unser Team besteht aus einzelnen Visionären mit Erfahrung in der Praxis und konzentriert sich auf die Lösungsfindung für die schwierigsten Märkte. Unsere Anwesenheit und unser Einfluss auf die Welt blieben konstant, wir hielten einen kleinen Kern und konzentrierten uns auf die Technologie, förderten eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Dank der Wertschöpfung für Integrität und Autonomie bietet unser Team die Möglichkeit, zum Lancio-Konzept beizutragen. Ich leite eine leidenschaftliche Leidenschaft für die permanente Ausbildung und eine Herausforderung für den Fortschritt der Freiheit. Wir legen großen Wert auf Produkte und Dienstleistungen mit hoher Qualität, mit einer kompromisslosen Innovationsgeschichte, die auf unserem Team basiert. ## Warum bist du zu uns gekommen? Innovationen bei Bitfinex, eine einzige Technologie und Kompetenz, um eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der Ihr Münzgeld nicht nur geschätzt wird, sondern Pionierarbeit in der Zukunft leistet und die Finanzgrenzen sprengt. Unsere Kultur wertet die kühne Kreativität, die Leidenschaft für die Technologie und ein hohes Maß an finanzieller Freiheit auf. Flexibilität und Portabilität auf globaler Ebene. Treuhand-, Autonomie- und Ergebnistreue: Unser Team operiert in der Ferne. Wir garantieren Ihnen, dass Sie bereit sind, mit einigen meiner besten Talente auf der ganzen Welt zusammenzuarbeiten. Prosperiamo grazie all'innovazione, all'autonomia und alla capacità di rompere new scheme. Ritmo veloce und impatto Proprio aus der Krypto-Wert-Branche stessa, und wir progetti si muovono velocemente, rompono new schemi und hanno no impatto. Ich habe zu unserer globalen Öffentlichkeit beigetragen und die Geschichte einer dezentralen Zukunft erzählt. Ein Team, das in der Zusammenarbeit erfolgreich sein wird, ist ein Team, das viel Wert auf neue Daten legt, mit kreativer Frische, der Garantie einer kostenintensiven Innovation, dem Mentor und einem Arbeitsklima, das Sie in Ihrer Arbeit und Ihren Aufgaben stets auf dem Laufenden hält. Berücksichtigen Sie die Integrität und die Qualität der Dinge, die Ihnen wichtig sind. Crescita mit den Besten In Bitfinex haben wir uns ständig darum gekümmert, während wir die technologische Weiterentwicklung vorangetrieben haben, und haben einen kreativen Workshop oder Mentor als Teil des professionellen Leiters des Unternehmens gemacht. Sie sind begeistert davon, an der Erstellung dezentralisierter Finanzberichte mitzuwirken und sich auf Ihr Zuhause zu konzentrieren. ## Stiamo gesucht: HR People Operations-Spezialist ## Stiamo hat sich derzeit um einen HR People Operations-Spezialisten für unser gesamtes Remote-Team und die globale Live-Verteilung gekümmert. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zu den Kosten bei und steuern den Rücken unserer Mitarbeiter, koordinieren und verwalten die täglichen HR-Prozesse, verwalten die Registrierungsgenauigkeit, unterstützen Onboarding und Offboarding und garantieren eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit HR, Finanzen und Führung. Diese Position ist ideal für meine Struktur, sie ist mit dem System und den Daten verbunden und muss ernsthaft dazu beitragen, ein Erlebnis ohne Probleme für unsere Kunden in der gesamten Welt zu schaffen. ## Porti al tavolo - Fähigkeit, selbstständig mit einem Mindestmaß an Aufsicht zu arbeiten, ein gutes Alter in einer vollständig entfernten Umgebung und in der Nähe - Starke organisatorische Fähigkeit und Aufmerksamkeit im Detail: Fähigkeit zur Geste, mehr Prozesse und Follow-up gleichzeitig - 3–5 Jahre alt Erfahrung im HR-Betrieb, Mitarbeiter & Engagement oder Projektkoordination (oder eine dieser Kombinationen) - Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit dem HR-System, Kalkulation und Zusammenarbeit - Gutes Verständnis der Prozesse, der Politik und der HR-Standards auf der Basis (Onboarding/Offboarding, Registrierungsverwaltung, Arbeit). (Ferien, Konformität mit der Basis) - Stärkere analytische und koordinative Arbeitsweise mit HR-Daten und -Betreibern - Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Englisch, mit der Spieß- und Prozessfähigkeit von HR in der Art und Weise, wie andere Kollegen als HR arbeiten - Eine auf die Person konzentrierte Annäherung: Sie ist ansprechbar, einfühlsam und mit Ihnen zusammen Ziel ist es, einen für die Verwaltung und Unterstützung der HR-Abteilung sichtbaren Zugangspunkt zu schaffen - Vertrauenswürdigkeit und Zusammenarbeit mit Managern und Mitarbeitern verschiedener Funktionen und Standorte - Eine proaktive und orientierte Lösung sowie Arbeitskoordination in einem dynamischen und weiterentwickelten Umfeld - Diskretion, Zuverlässigkeit und strenge Aufmerksamkeit auf Sicherheit und Privatsphäre im Umgang mit persönlichen Daten – die Neugier gegenüber Kryptowährungen, Fintechs oder Organisationen, die von der Technologie geleitet werden, ist ein Vorteil. ## Angeboten: - Flexibler Arbeitsplatz und bevorzugte Kultur am entfernten Arbeitsplatz - Mentor und Crescita - Wettbewerbsrückerstattung - Professionelle Entwicklungschancen - Solides Arbeitsklima - Kontinuitätstraining und Teambuilding - Teambuilding-Aktivität - Soziale Aktivität (online und in Anwesenheit) ## Wollen Sie mir bald die Freiheit der Finanzen in die Wiege legen? Wenn Sie eine Vision haben, die durch Technologie, Wissen und Innovation gedeihen wird, haben Sie sich entschieden! ## Geben Sie Ihre Anmeldedaten und Ihre Sicherheit ein. Als Teil des Bitfinex-Anmeldevorgangs senden wir Ihnen persönliche Daten zu Ihrem Namen, Ihren Kontakten, Ihrer Position, Ihrer Wunschvorstellung, Ihrer Verwaltung und Ihrer Arbeitsgeschichte sowie weiteren Informationen, die Sie erhalten fornisci volontariamente. Diese Daten werden ausschließlich für die Aufnahme in die Datenschutzerklärung verwendet, im Einklang mit den auf den Datenschutz anwendbaren Rechten weltweit ausgearbeitet, durch die allgemeine Regulierung des Datenschutzes (DSGVO) und den California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) und nur in dem für die Einhaltung des Datenschutzes erforderlichen Tempo eingehalten. Alle Bewertungen und Mitteilungen zur Rekrutierung erfolgen ausschließlich per E-Mail an Bitfinex (z. B. vorname.nachname@bitfinex.com). Bitfinex nutzt keine nicht offiziellen Kanäle (wie WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS) für die Kommunikation und die Nichtverteilung von Werten oder Link-Sensibilis mit diesen Mezzis. Im Rahmen unseres sicheren und konformen Rekrutierungsprozesses können wir die Formulare der dritten Partei nutzen, um die Bewertung der Kandidaten zu erleichtern. Um weitere Informationen zu erhalten, bitten wir Sie, alle unsere Informationen zum Datenschutz der Kandidaten und im Einvernehmen mit der Registrierung der Interessenten einzuholen. Alle Kandidaten haben sich zu ihrem Beitritt verpflichtet, sie haben ihre persönlichen Daten zu korrigieren oder zu widerrufen und die Zustimmung zu jedem Zeitpunkt zu widerrufen, sofern zutreffend. Wenn Sie ein reicher Kunde sind, bitten wir Sie, Ihre Daten in Bezug auf den Datenschutz zu prüfen oder weitere Informationen zu erhalten, um die rechtlichen Anforderungen des Prozesses zu erfüllen, und wenden Sie sich an Privacy@bitfinex.com. Ich möchte Sie darauf aufmerksam machen, dass dieses Posthaus nur dazu bestimmt ist, sich mit der Privatsphäre zu befassen und es zu schützen. Bitte beachten Sie, dass die weitere Kommunikation nicht sorgfältig ausgearbeitet wurde. ## Dichiarazione sulle pari opportunità In Bitfinex, siamo impegnati agarantire pari opportunità. descriptionByLocale.fr: Description de The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspiré de la vision du Bitcoin de la liberté financière, nous imprégnons à toute personne la possibilité d'effectuer des transactions et de se connecter sans problème dans tout le monde. Fin des premiers jours de la révolution Bitcoin, notre mission est de promouvoir la liberté en utilisant une technologie innovante, fiable et accessible, garantissant que tous, bien sûr, permettent aux instruments de participer à un monde vraiment ouvert et sans limite. Nous sommes guidés par une recherche incessante d’innovation et d’émancipation financière. En donnant la priorité à l'éducation et en fournissant une place à l'avant-garde, nous permettons aux utilisateurs d'acquérir, de détenir et d'utiliser les actifs numériques en toute sécurité et sans problème. Alors que le panorama des actifs numériques évolue rapidement, nous nous dirigeons vers l'avant-garde, offrant des services de trading vers l'avant-garde qui peuvent permettre aux particuliers de fournir des liquidités mondiales. Notre approche est longue et agile, garantissant que la liberté financière n'est pas seulement une vision, mais une réalité pour tout. Notre équipe, composée de visionnaires individuels avec une expérience pratique, se concentre sur la création de solutions pour les plus difficiles du marché. Malgré notre présence et notre impact mondial, nous conservons un noyau petit et focalisé sur la technologie, promouvons une culture de collaboration et d'innovation. Nous valorisons l'intégrité et l'autonomie, et nous avons également la possibilité de contribuer au projet de lancement. Guidés par une passion pour l'apprentissage permanent et par un élan pour le progrès de la liberté, nous donnons la priorité aux produits et aux services de haute qualité, avec une histoire d'innovation basée sur la destruction de notre équipe. ## Pourquoi tu vas à ce soir ? Innovation Chez Bitfinex, nous avons une technologie et des compétences uniques pour créer un environnement dans lequel votre investissement n'est pas seulement apprécié, mais le pionnier de l'avenir et de l'avenir et des limites du financement. Notre culture valorise l'audace de la créativité, la passion pour la technologie et une profonde contribution à la liberté financière. Rythme rapide et impact propre à l'industrie des crypto-monnaies, et nos projets sont très rapides, rompant de nouveaux schémas et ayant un impact. J'ai contribué à enrichir notre public public mondial, à alimenter la narration d'un futur décentralisé. Si vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée de participer à la création de la narration de la finance décentralisée, vous vous sentirez à la maison. ## Nous recherchons : Spécialiste RH People Operations ## Il dirige Stiamo actuellement à la recherche d'un Spécialiste RH People Operations pour l'université de notre équipe à distance et distribué au niveau mondial. Dans ce cadre, j'ai contribué à la construction et à la gestion de la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle de notre fonction People, en coordonnant les processus RH quotidiens, en maintenant les registres précis, en soutenant l'onboarding et le offboarding et en garantissant une collaboration fluide entre les RH, les finances et le leadership. descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione The Original Bitcoin Exchange Ispirati dalla visione di Bitcoin di libertà finanziaria siamo impegnati a osare alle persone la possibilità di effettuare correttamente e connettersi senza problemi in tutto il mondo. Siamo guidati da una ricerca incessante di innovazione e di emancipazione finanziaria. Dando priorità all'educazione e competenze una piattaforma all'avanguardia, permettere agli utenti di acquistare, detenere e scambiare asset digitali in modo sicuro e senza problemi. Valorizzare l'alimentazione e l'autonomia, dando al nostro team la possibilità di contribuire dal concetto lancio. Guidati da una passione per l'apprendimento permanente e da un impegno per il progresso della libertà, diamo priorità a prodotti e servizi di alta qualità, con una comprovata storia di innovazione che si basa sulla destrezza dei nostri team. # Perché unirti a noi? Innovazione In Bitfinex, uniamo tecnologia e competenza per creare un ambiente in cui il tuo coinvolgimento non è solo apprezzato, ma sta pionerizzando il futuro e spingendo i confini della finanza. La nostra cultura valorizza la creatività audace, la passione per la tecnologia e una profonda fede nella libertà finanziaria. Flessibilità e portata globale Crediamo nella fiducia, nell'autonomia e nei risultati: il nostro team opera in grado di lavorare da qualsiasi luogo collaborando con alcuni dei migliori talenti di tutto il mondo. Prosperiamo grazie all'innovazione, all'autonomia e alla capacità di sfondare nuovi schemi. Ritmo veloce e impatto proprio come l'industria delle criptovalute stessa i nostri progetti si muovono velocemente, rompono nuovi e hanno un impatto. I tuoi contributi raggiungono il nostro pubblico globale, plasmando la narrazione di un futuro decentralizzato. Un team che prospera grazie alla collaborazione Uniamo esperti di lunga data con menti creativi freschi, garanti un'innovazione costante, il mentorato e un ambiente di lavoro dinamico che ti mantiene all'avanguardia nel raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi. descriptionByLocale.en: The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world. We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all. Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams. Why Join Us? • Innovation At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom. • Flexibility & Global Reach We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground. • Fast-Paced & Impactful Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future. • A Team that Thrives on Collaboration We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities. • Grow with the Best At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry. If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home. We’re looking for: HR People Operations Specialist The Role We’re currently looking for an HR People Operations Specialist to join our remote-first, globally distributed team. In this role, you will help build and run the operational backbone of our People function—coordinating day-to-day HR processes, maintaining accurate records, supporting onboarding and offboarding, and ensuring smooth collaboration between HR, Finance, and leadership. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys structure, is comfortable with systems and data, and cares deeply about creating a seamless experience for our team members around the world. What You Bring to the Table • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, comfortable in a fully remote, asynchronous environment • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail—able to manage multiple processes and follow-ups at once • At least 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, people & engagement, or project coordination (or a combination of these) • Experience working with HR systems, spreadsheets, and collaborative tools • Good understanding of core HR processes, policies and standards (onboarding/offboarding, records management, time-off tracking, basic compliance) • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with HR and operational data • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain HR processes clearly to non-HR colleagues • A people-centred approach: you are approachable, empathetic, and comfortable being a visible, go-to contact for HR questions and support • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate with managers and team members across functions and locations • A proactive, solution-oriented approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment • Discretion, reliability, and a strong focus on security and privacy in handling personal data • Curiosity about crypto, fintech, or technology-driven organizations is a plus. What We Offer: • Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture • Mentorship & Growth • Competitive Pay • Career Development Opportunities • Supportive Team Environment • Learning & Knowledge Sharing • Team-Building Activities • Social activities (online & in-person) Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all? If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you! Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose. All assessments and recruitment-related communications are conducted exclusively through official Bitfinex email addresses (e.g., firstname.lastname@bitfinex.com ). Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means. As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent . All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable. Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process. If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com . Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed . Equal Opportunity Statement At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description de The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspiré de la vision du Bitcoin de la liberté financière, nous imprégnons à toute personne la possibilité d'effectuer des transactions et de se connecter sans problème dans tout le monde. Fin des premiers jours de la révolution Bitcoin, notre mission est de promouvoir la liberté en utilisant une technologie innovante, fiable et accessible, garantissant que tous, bien sûr, permettent aux instruments de participer à un monde vraiment ouvert et sans limite. Nous sommes guidés par une recherche incessante d’innovation et d’émancipation financière. En donnant la priorité à l'éducation et en fournissant une place à l'avant-garde, nous permettons aux utilisateurs d'acquérir, de détenir et d'utiliser les actifs numériques en toute sécurité et sans problème. Alors que le panorama des actifs numériques évolue rapidement, nous nous dirigeons vers l'avant-garde, offrant des services de trading vers l'avant-garde qui peuvent permettre aux particuliers de fournir des liquidités mondiales. Notre approche est longue et agile, garantissant que la liberté financière n'est pas seulement une vision, mais une réalité pour tout. Notre équipe, composée de visionnaires individuels avec une expérience pratique, se concentre sur la création de solutions pour les plus difficiles du marché. Malgré notre présence et notre impact mondial, nous conservons un noyau petit et focalisé sur la technologie, promouvons une culture de collaboration et d'innovation. Nous valorisons l'intégrité et l'autonomie, et nous avons également la possibilité de contribuer au projet de lancement. Guidés par une passion pour l'apprentissage permanent et par un élan pour le progrès de la liberté, nous donnons la priorité aux produits et aux services de haute qualité, avec une histoire d'innovation basée sur la destruction de notre équipe. ## Pourquoi tu vas à ce soir ? Innovation Chez Bitfinex, nous avons une technologie et des compétences uniques pour créer un environnement dans lequel votre investissement n'est pas seulement apprécié, mais le pionnier de l'avenir et de l'avenir et des limites du financement. Notre culture valorise l'audace de la créativité, la passion pour la technologie et une profonde contribution à la liberté financière. Flexibilité et portabilité globale du crédit dans la fiducie, dans l'autonomie et dans les résultats : notre équipe opère à distance, garantissant que vous pourrez travailler de quelqu'un d'autre en collaborant avec quelques-uns des meilleurs talents de tout le monde. descriptionByLocale.en: The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world. We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all. Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams. Why Join Us? • Innovation At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom. • Flexibility & Global Reach We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground. • Fast-Paced & Impactful Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future. • A Team that Thrives on Collaboration We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities. • Grow with the Best At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry. If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home. We’re looking for: HR People Operations Specialist The Role We’re currently looking for an HR People Operations Specialist to join our remote-first, globally distributed team. In this role, you will help build and run the operational backbone of our People function—coordinating day-to-day HR processes, maintaining accurate records, supporting onboarding and offboarding, and ensuring smooth collaboration between HR, Finance, and leadership. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys structure, is comfortable with systems and data, and cares deeply about creating a seamless experience for our team members around the world. What You Bring to the Table • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, comfortable in a fully remote, asynchronous environment • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail—able to manage multiple processes and follow-ups at once • At least 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, people & engagement, or project coordination (or a combination of these) • Experience working with HR systems, spreadsheets, and collaborative tools • Good understanding of core HR processes, policies and standards (onboarding/offboarding, records management, time-off tracking, basic compliance) • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with HR and operational data • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain HR processes clearly to non-HR colleagues • A people-centred approach: you are approachable, empathetic, and comfortable being a visible, go-to contact for HR questions and support • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate with managers and team members across functions and locations • A proactive, solution-oriented approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment • Discretion, reliability, and a strong focus on security and privacy in handling personal data • Curiosity about crypto, fintech, or technology-driven organizations is a plus. What We Offer: • Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture • Mentorship & Growth • Competitive Pay • Career Development Opportunities • Supportive Team Environment • Learning & Knowledge Sharing • Team-Building Activities • Social activities (online & in-person) Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all? If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you! Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose. All assessments and recruitment-related communications are conducted exclusively through official Bitfinex email addresses (e.g., firstname.lastname@bitfinex.com ). Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means. As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent . All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable. Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process. If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com . Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed . Equal Opportunity Statement At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Description de The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspiré de la vision du Bitcoin de la liberté financière, nous imprégnons à toute personne la possibilité d'effectuer des transactions et de se connecter sans problème dans tout le monde. En donnant la priorité à l'éducation et en fournissant une place à l'avant-garde, nous permettons aux utilisateurs d'acquérir, de détenir et d'utiliser les actifs numériques en toute sécurité et sans problème. Alors que le panorama des actifs numériques évolue rapidement, nous nous dirigeons vers l'avant-garde, offrant des services de trading vers l'avant-garde qui peuvent permettre aux particuliers de fournir des liquidités mondiales. Notre approche est longue et agile, garantissant que la liberté financière n'est pas seulement une vision, mais une réalité pour tout. Malgré notre présence et notre impact mondial, nous conservons un noyau petit et focalisé sur la technologie, promouvons une culture de collaboration et d'innovation. Nous valorisons l'intégrité et l'autonomie, et nous avons également la possibilité de contribuer au projet de lancement. Guidés par une passion pour l'apprentissage permanent et par un élan pour le progrès de la liberté, nous donnons la priorité aux produits et aux services de haute qualité, avec une histoire d'innovation basée sur la destruction de notre équipe. ## Pourquoi tu vas à ce soir ? Tutti i candidati hanno il diritto di accedere, correggere o cancellare i propri dati personali e di revocare il consenso in qualsiasi momento, se applicabile. Bitfinex non richiederà mai pagamenti, informazioni finanziarie o dettagli bancari personali in alcuna fase del processo di reclutamento. Se ricevi una richiesta sospetta, previa i tuoi diritti sulla privacy dei dati o hai ulteriori domande riguardo agli aspetti legali del processo, contatta privacy@bitfinex.com. descriptionByLocale.en: The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world. We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all. Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams. Why Join Us? • Innovation At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom. • Flexibility & Global Reach We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground. • Fast-Paced & Impactful Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future. • A Team that Thrives on Collaboration We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities. • Grow with the Best At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry. If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home. We’re looking for: HR People Operations Specialist The Role We’re currently looking for an HR People Operations Specialist to join our remote-first, globally distributed team. In this role, you will help build and run the operational backbone of our People function—coordinating day-to-day HR processes, maintaining accurate records, supporting onboarding and offboarding, and ensuring smooth collaboration between HR, Finance, and leadership. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys structure, is comfortable with systems and data, and cares deeply about creating a seamless experience for our team members around the world. What You Bring to the Table • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, comfortable in a fully remote, asynchronous environment • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail—able to manage multiple processes and follow-ups at once • At least 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, people & engagement, or project coordination (or a combination of these) • Experience working with HR systems, spreadsheets, and collaborative tools • Good understanding of core HR processes, policies and standards (onboarding/offboarding, records management, time-off tracking, basic compliance) • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with HR and operational data • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain HR processes clearly to non-HR colleagues • A people-centred approach: you are approachable, empathetic, and comfortable being a visible, go-to contact for HR questions and support • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate with managers and team members across functions and locations • A proactive, solution-oriented approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment • Discretion, reliability, and a strong focus on security and privacy in handling personal data • Curiosity about crypto, fintech, or technology-driven organizations is a plus. What We Offer: • Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture • Mentorship & Growth • Competitive Pay • Career Development Opportunities • Supportive Team Environment • Learning & Knowledge Sharing • Team-Building Activities • Social activities (online & in-person) Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all? If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you! Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose. All assessments and recruitment-related communications are conducted exclusively through official Bitfinex email addresses (e.g., firstname.lastname@bitfinex.com ). Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means. As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent . All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable. Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process. If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com . Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed . Equal Opportunity Statement At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Beschreibung von The Original Bitcoin Exchange basiert auf der Vision von Bitcoin in der freien Finanzwelt und bietet allen Menschen die Möglichkeit, Transaktionen durchzuführen und sich ohne Probleme in der ganzen Welt zu verbinden. Nach den ersten Schritten der Bitcoin-Entwicklung ist unsere Mission der Grund, die Freiheit zu fördern, indem sie eine innovative, zuverlässige und zugängliche Technologie vertritt, die alles garantiert, jedes Jahr, aber nur wenige Instrumente für die Teilnahme an einer Welt, die wahrheitsgemäss und ohne Einschränkungen ist. Siamo leitet eine unaufhörliche Innovation und Emanzipation im Finanzwesen. Da die gesamte Bildung Vorrang hat und eine allgemeine Schulungsmaßnahme erforderlich ist, können Sie nur bestimmte Erwerbsutensilien verwenden, digitale Vermögenswerte in sicherer Form und ohne Probleme aufbewahren und betrügen. Während sich das digitale Asset-Panorama rasant entwickelt, die gesamte Avantgarde abbaut, bieten wir Dienstleistungen für den Allavantgarde-Handel an, die dann für Einzelpersonen und globale Liquiditätsgeber nützlich sein können. Unser Ansatz ist einfach und flexibel, um sicherzustellen, dass die Finanzfreiheit nicht allein eine Vision ist, sondern eine Realität für Sie. Unser Team besteht aus einzelnen Visionären mit Erfahrung in der Praxis und konzentriert sich auf die Lösungsfindung für die schwierigsten Märkte. Unsere Anwesenheit und unser Einfluss auf die Welt blieben konstant, wir hielten einen kleinen Kern und konzentrierten uns auf die Technologie, förderten eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Dank der Wertschöpfung für Integrität und Autonomie bietet unser Team die Möglichkeit, zum Lancio-Konzept beizutragen. Ich leite eine leidenschaftliche Leidenschaft für die permanente Ausbildung und eine Herausforderung für den Fortschritt der Freiheit. Wir legen großen Wert auf Produkte und Dienstleistungen mit hoher Qualität, mit einer kompromisslosen Innovationsgeschichte, die auf unserem Team basiert. ## Warum bist du zu uns gekommen? Innovationen bei Bitfinex, eine einzige Technologie und Kompetenz, um eine Umgebung zu schaffen, in der Ihr Münzgeld nicht nur geschätzt wird, sondern Pionierarbeit in der Zukunft leistet und die Finanzgrenzen sprengt. Unsere Kultur wertet die kühne Kreativität, die Leidenschaft für die Technologie und ein hohes Maß an finanzieller Freiheit auf. Flexibilität und Portabilität auf globaler Ebene. Treuhand-, Autonomie- und Ergebnistreue: Unser Team operiert in der Ferne. Wir garantieren Ihnen, dass Sie bereit sind, mit einigen meiner besten Talente auf der ganzen Welt zusammenzuarbeiten. Prosperiamo grazie all'innovazione, all'autonomia und alla capacità di rompere new scheme. Ritmo veloce und impatto Proprio aus der Krypto-Wert-Branche stessa, und wir progetti si muovono velocemente, rompono new schemi und hanno no impatto. Ich habe zu unserer globalen Öffentlichkeit beigetragen und die Geschichte einer dezentralen Zukunft erzählt. Ein Team, das in der Zusammenarbeit erfolgreich sein wird, ist ein Team, das viel Wert auf neue Daten legt, mit kreativer Frische, der Garantie einer kostenintensiven Innovation, dem Mentor und einem Arbeitsklima, das Sie in Ihrer Arbeit und Ihren Aufgaben stets auf dem Laufenden hält. Berücksichtigen Sie die Integrität und die Qualität der Dinge, die Ihnen wichtig sind. Crescita mit den Besten In Bitfinex haben wir uns ständig darum gekümmert, während wir die technologische Weiterentwicklung vorangetrieben haben, und haben einen kreativen Workshop oder Mentor als Teil des professionellen Leiters des Unternehmens gemacht. Sie sind begeistert davon, an der Erstellung dezentralisierter Finanzberichte mitzuwirken und sich auf Ihr Zuhause zu konzentrieren. ## Stiamo gesucht: HR People Operations-Spezialist ## Stiamo hat sich derzeit um einen HR People Operations-Spezialisten für unser gesamtes Remote-Team und die globale Live-Verteilung gekümmert. In dieser Rolle tragen Sie zu den Kosten bei und steuern den Rücken unserer Mitarbeiter, koordinieren und verwalten die täglichen HR-Prozesse, verwalten die Registrierungsgenauigkeit, unterstützen Onboarding und Offboarding und garantieren eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit HR, Finanzen und Führung. Diese Position ist ideal für meine Struktur, sie ist mit dem System und den Daten verbunden und muss ernsthaft dazu beitragen, ein Erlebnis ohne Probleme für unsere Kunden in der gesamten Welt zu schaffen. ## Porti al tavolo - Fähigkeit, selbstständig mit einem Mindestmaß an Aufsicht zu arbeiten, ein gutes Alter in einer vollständig entfernten Umgebung und in der Nähe - Starke organisatorische Fähigkeit und Aufmerksamkeit im Detail: Fähigkeit zur Geste, mehr Prozesse und Follow-up gleichzeitig - 3–5 Jahre alt Erfahrung im HR-Betrieb, Mitarbeiter & Engagement oder Projektkoordination (oder eine dieser Kombinationen) - Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit dem HR-System, Kalkulation und Zusammenarbeit - Gutes Verständnis der Prozesse, der Politik und der HR-Standards auf der Basis (Onboarding/Offboarding, Registrierungsverwaltung, Arbeit). (Ferien, Konformität mit der Basis) - Stärkere analytische und koordinative Arbeitsweise mit HR-Daten und -Betreibern - Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Englisch, mit der Spieß- und Prozessfähigkeit von HR in der Art und Weise, wie andere Kollegen als HR arbeiten - Eine auf die Person konzentrierte Annäherung: Sie ist ansprechbar, einfühlsam und mit Ihnen zusammen Ziel ist es, einen für die Verwaltung und Unterstützung der HR-Abteilung sichtbaren Zugangspunkt zu schaffen - Vertrauenswürdigkeit und Zusammenarbeit mit Managern und Mitarbeitern verschiedener Funktionen und Standorte - Eine proaktive und orientierte Lösung sowie Arbeitskoordination in einem dynamischen und weiterentwickelten Umfeld - Diskretion, Zuverlässigkeit und strenge Aufmerksamkeit auf Sicherheit und Privatsphäre im Umgang mit persönlichen Daten – die Neugier gegenüber Kryptowährungen, Fintechs oder Organisationen, die von der Technologie geleitet werden, ist ein Vorteil. ## Angeboten: - Flexibler Arbeitsplatz und bevorzugte Kultur am entfernten Arbeitsplatz - Mentor und Crescita - Wettbewerbsrückerstattung - Professionelle Entwicklungschancen - Solides Arbeitsklima - Kontinuitätstraining und Teambuilding - Teambuilding-Aktivität - Soziale Aktivität (online und in Anwesenheit) ## Wollen Sie mir bald die Freiheit der Finanzen in die Wiege legen? Wenn Sie eine Vision haben, die durch Technologie, Wissen und Innovation gedeihen wird, haben Sie sich entschieden! ## Geben Sie Ihre Anmeldedaten und Ihre Sicherheit ein. Als Teil des Bitfinex-Anmeldevorgangs senden wir Ihnen persönliche Daten zu Ihrem Namen, Ihren Kontakten, Ihrer Position, Ihrer Wunschvorstellung, Ihrer Verwaltung und Ihrer Arbeitsgeschichte sowie weiteren Informationen, die Sie erhalten fornisci volontariamente. Diese Daten werden ausschließlich für die Aufnahme in die Datenschutzerklärung verwendet, im Einklang mit den auf den Datenschutz anwendbaren Rechten weltweit ausgearbeitet, durch die allgemeine Regulierung des Datenschutzes (DSGVO) und den California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) und nur in dem für die Einhaltung des Datenschutzes erforderlichen Tempo eingehalten. Alle Bewertungen und Mitteilungen zur Rekrutierung erfolgen ausschließlich per E-Mail an Bitfinex (z. B. vorname.nachname@bitfinex.com). Bitfinex nutzt keine nicht offiziellen Kanäle (wie WhatsApp, Telegram oder SMS) für die Kommunikation und die Nichtverteilung von Werten oder Link-Sensibilis mit diesen Mezzis. Im Rahmen unseres sicheren und konformen Rekrutierungsprozesses können wir die Formulare der dritten Partei nutzen, um die Bewertung der Kandidaten zu erleichtern. Um weitere Informationen zu erhalten, bitten wir Sie, alle unsere Informationen zum Datenschutz der Kandidaten und im Einvernehmen mit der Registrierung der Interessenten einzuholen. Alle Kandidaten haben sich zu ihrem Beitritt verpflichtet, sie haben ihre persönlichen Daten zu korrigieren oder zu widerrufen und die Zustimmung zu jedem Zeitpunkt zu widerrufen, sofern zutreffend. Bitfinex hat nicht viel Geld verdient, informierte Finanziers oder detaillierte persönliche Banknoten in der ersten Phase des Rekrutierungsvorgangs. Wenn Sie ein reicher Kunde sind, bitten wir Sie, Ihre Daten in Bezug auf den Datenschutz zu prüfen oder weitere Informationen zu erhalten, um die rechtlichen Anforderungen des Prozesses zu erfüllen, und wenden Sie sich an Privacy@bitfinex.com. Ich möchte Sie darauf aufmerksam machen, dass dieses Posthaus nur dazu bestimmt ist, sich mit der Privatsphäre zu befassen und es zu schützen. Bitte beachten Sie, dass die weitere Kommunikation nicht sorgfältig ausgearbeitet wurde. ## Dichiarazione sulle pari opportunità In Bitfinex, siamo impegnati agarantire pari opportunità. Nichtdiskriminierung aufgrund von Rasse, Religion, Geschlecht, Geschlecht, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder anderen geschützten Bedingungen. Dieses Problem besteht darin, alle Rekrutierungs- und Vertragsbeziehungen anzuwenden.

descriptionByLocale.en: The Original Bitcoin Exchange Inspired by Bitcoin's vision of financial freedom, we are committed to empowering individuals to transact and connect seamlessly across the globe. From the early days of the Bitcoin revolution, our mission has been to champion freedom through innovative, reliable, and accessible technology—ensuring that everyone, everywhere, has the tools to participate in a truly open and borderless world. We are driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation and financial empowerment. By prioritizing education and delivering a cutting-edge platform, we enable users to seamlessly buy, hold, and trade digital assets with confidence. As the digital asset landscape rapidly evolves, we stay ahead—offering state-of-the-art trading services that empower both individuals and global liquidity providers. Our forward-thinking, agile approach ensures that financial freedom is not just a vision, but a reality for all. Our team, composed of visionary individuals with practical expertise, focuses on crafting solutions to the market's toughest challenges. Despite our global presence and impact, we maintain a small, technology-focused core, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation. We value integrity and autonomy, empowering our team to contribute from concept to launch. Driven by a passion for lifelong learning and a commitment to advancing freedom, we prioritize high-caliber products and services, with a proven track record of innovation that draws on the dexterity of our teams. Why Join Us? • Innovation At Bitfinex, we merge technology and skill to create an environment where your involvement isn’t just appreciated—it’s pioneering the future and pushing boundaries in finance. Our culture values bold creativity, a passion for technology, and a deep belief in Financial Freedom. • Flexibility & Global Reach We believe in trust, autonomy, and results—our team operates remotely, ensuring you work from anywhere while collaborating with some of the best talents across the world. We thrive on innovation, autonomy, and breaking new ground. • Fast-Paced & Impactful Much like the crypto industry itself, our projects move fast, break new ground, and make an impact. Your contributions reach our global audience, shaping the narrative of a decentralized future. • A Team that Thrives on Collaboration We blend seasoned experts with fresh creative minds, ensuring constant innovation, mentorship, and a dynamic work environment that keeps you at the forefront of achieving your goals. We see integrity and standing up for what is right as the most important qualities. • Grow with the Best At Bitfinex, we’re committed to continuous learning—whether through technological advancements, creative workshops, or mentorship from leading professionals in the industry. If you’re excited about partaking in shaping the narrative of decentralized finance, you’ll feel right at home. We’re looking for: HR People Operations Specialist The Role We’re currently looking for an HR People Operations Specialist to join our remote-first, globally distributed team. In this role, you will help build and run the operational backbone of our People function—coordinating day-to-day HR processes, maintaining accurate records, supporting onboarding and offboarding, and ensuring smooth collaboration between HR, Finance, and leadership. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys structure, is comfortable with systems and data, and cares deeply about creating a seamless experience for our team members around the world. What You Bring to the Table • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision, comfortable in a fully remote, asynchronous environment • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail—able to manage multiple processes and follow-ups at once • At least 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, people & engagement, or project coordination (or a combination of these) • Experience working with HR systems, spreadsheets, and collaborative tools • Good understanding of core HR processes, policies and standards (onboarding/offboarding, records management, time-off tracking, basic compliance) • Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with HR and operational data • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain HR processes clearly to non-HR colleagues • A people-centred approach: you are approachable, empathetic, and comfortable being a visible, go-to contact for HR questions and support • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate with managers and team members across functions and locations • A proactive, solution-oriented approach and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment • Discretion, reliability, and a strong focus on security and privacy in handling personal data • Curiosity about crypto, fintech, or technology-driven organizations is a plus. What We Offer: • Flexible Work & Remote-Friendly Culture • Mentorship & Growth • Competitive Pay • Career Development Opportunities • Supportive Team Environment • Learning & Knowledge Sharing • Team-Building Activities • Social activities (online & in-person) Ready to join us in bringing Financial Freedom to all? If you’re a visionary who thrives at the intersection of technology, knowledge and innovation, we want to hear from you! Recruitment Data & Security Disclaimer As part of the hiring process at Bitfinex, we collect personal data such as your name, contact details, location, job preferences, education and employment history, and other information you voluntarily provide. This data is used solely for recruitment purposes, processed in accordance with applicable global data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil its purpose. Bitfinex does not use unofficial channels (such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS) for recruitment communication and does not distribute assessments or sensitive links via those means. As part of our secure and compliant recruitment process, we may use approved third-party platforms to facilitate candidate assessments. For more information, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice and Interview Recording Consent . All candidates have the right to access, correct, or delete their personal data and to withdraw consent at any time, where applicable. Bitfinex will never request payments, financial information, or personal banking details at any stage of the recruitment process. If you receive a suspicious request, wish to exercise your data privacy rights, or have further inquiries regarding the legal aspects of the process, contact privacy@bitfinex.com . Please note this inbox is intended for privacy concerns and reports only; any other communications will not be processed . Equal Opportunity Statement At Bitfinex, we're committed to equitable opportunities. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. This commitment applies across all stages of recruitment and contractual relationships.

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi 

What you will do:

• Independent operation and execution of downstream related activities according to specified instructions (manufacturing protocols / operating instructions / work instructions / SOP)

• Safe and correct execution of work in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account the cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order at the workplace as well as the assigned rooms and storage areas

• Performing monitoring, maintenance, and cleaning tasks, as well as reporting and rectifying defects and malfunctions in the facility, including their documentation

• Every employee is involved as an equal team member through their active participation in continuous improvement processes

What we are looking for:

• Completed professional training (Apprenticeship)

• Chemical or pharmaceutical-technical training as well as GMP and/or BICO training advantageous

• Good skills in speaking, writing, and comprehension in German or English required.

• Accurate work and documentation practices

• Execution of tasks with a high level of safety and quality awareness

• Willingness to work shifts (4-shift operation) with flexibility in work scheduling

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Ingresso come macchinista per il traffico passeggeri 12/2026 Coira, 01.12.2026, 100% Ora candidati ## Ciò che puoi aspettarti. Come macchinista, fai grandi cose: presso FFS Traffico passeggeri, muovi circa 482 milioni di viaggiatori ogni anno. Dopo aver completato la formazione retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro ti porta lungo le più belle linee ferroviarie della Svizzera. In questo modo, i nostri passeggeri arrivano puntuali a destinazione e si assicurano un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con FFS. La tua vita quotidiana è piena di prospettive anche con condizioni di lavoro attraenti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Il lavoro notturno e quello di fine settimana sono inoltre retribuiti - ad esempio, con 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro di domenica. Nelle missioni notturne, hai inoltre supplementi orari tra il 10 e il 30 percento. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione come macchinista, puoi organizzare il tuo orario di lavoro individuale a partire dal 60 percento, con diversi modelli di part-time a disposizione. Scopri di più sull'immagine professionale alla prossima manifestazione informativa e visitaci alla prossima visita della cabina di guida. ## Ciò che puoi fare. - Come macchinista, non solo prendi il comando del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla rete ferroviaria densamente trafficata. - Durante il viaggio, sei attento e reagisci velocemente e correttamente ai segnali, ai regolamenti di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e le sale di controllo. - Oltre a guidare e manovrare i treni, il controllo dello stato tecnico prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo fa parte dei tuoi compiti. ## Ciò che porti con te. - Hai completato un'apprendistato triennale o la maturità. La tua motivazione è più importante per noi della branca da cui vieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ponderate anche in situazioni stressanti e sei disposto a lavorare in turni. - Sei sicuro nella trattativa in tedesco (livello C2) e hai conoscenze di base di una seconda lingua nazionale (livello A1). - Hai un senso dei colori perfetto (nessuna debolezza rosso-verde) e non hai registri penali o di esecuzione. - Per il periodo di formazione intensivo e impegnativo, porti con te molta responsabilità personale e motivazione e sei disposto a adattarti a diversi ambienti di apprendimento - dalla lezione in presenza sul posto allo studio digitale autonomo. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Entry as a train driver for passenger traffic 12/2026 Chur, 01.12.2026, 100% Apply now ## What you can look forward to. As a train driver, you do great things: At FFS Passenger Traffic, you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month training, the job takes you along the most beautiful railway lines in Switzerland. In doing so, you bring our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with FFS. Your everyday work is also full of perspectives with attractive working conditions for all life situations. Night and weekend work are additionally compensated - for example, with 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. During night shifts, you also have time supplements between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training as a train driver, you can design your individual working hours from 60 percent, with different part-time models available. Learn more about the professional image at the next information event and visit us at the next driver's cab visit. ## What you can do. - As a train driver, you not only take the lead of the train, but also take responsibility for safety and punctuality on the densely used rail network. - During your journey, you are attentive and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed regulations and unpredictable events. - You act independently and are always in contact with operational centers and control rooms. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle is part of your tasks. ## What you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or maturity. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work in shifts. - You are negotiation-safe in German (level C2) and have basic knowledge of a second national language (level A1). - You have a perfect color sense (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal and execution register. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and motivation with you and are willing to adapt to different learning environments - from on-site classroom instruction to digital self-study. ## Your salary and benefits. The classification during the dual training takes place according to the function and age. You can find more information on the concrete salary for this role under Entry. ## This is how the entry works. That you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. ## Descrizione
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification. In this role you will be part in pioneering a new way of working within our Smart Power Division. You will implement and lead the Agile practices at team level for one or more teams. You will guide on the Agile principles, helping the team to achieve valuable outcomes, and identify continuous improvement, bringing a data driven approach in day‑to‑day management. The work model for the role is: hybrid #LI-hybrid

## Mansioni
- Guide and coach Scrum teams in applying Agile practices and principles, fostering positive team dynamics, collaboration, and continuous improvement
- Develop high‑performing teams by identifying strengths and areas for growth, using effective coaching techniques, and promoting empowering Agile behaviors
- Facilitate key Scrum event s (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective) to ensure engagement, transparency, and smooth delivery
- Strengthen Agile maturity across the organization by building cross‑team alliances, improving Agile practices, and ensuring adherence to Scrum theory, practices, and guidelines

## Requisiti
- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent (this position is not embedded in the IT environment; we are open for profiles with different backgrounds like psychology, social science, engineering, business administration, economics etc.)
- 5 or more years of e xperience as Scrum Master or in a similar Agile role applying Agile principles and practices is an advantage
- Fluent command of English with Italian considered as additional advantage
- Motivated to work in an Agile, dynamic workplace and cross functional team
- Experience in leading people with the ability to earn trust while challenging the team to improve and operate outside its comfort zone
- Strong creative problem – solving skills and the ability to get things done
- Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, coaching, risk management and conflict‑resolution skills, with the ability to foster positive team dynamics and collaboration

## Contatto
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

## Verkäufer:in Food

**Coop Genossenschaft** — Arosa, Graubünden, Svizzera

## Aufgaben
- Du liebst die Abwechslung, darum bedienst und berätst du unsere Kundschaft in verschiedenen Abteilungen – stets freundlich und engagiert.
- Dank deinem aktiven Einsatz verkaufen sich die Waren besser und werden top bewirtschaftet.
- Klar, dass du unsere Vorgaben einhältst, sei es bei Frische und Qualität, punkto Hygiene, Temperaturvorschriften oder des Verfalldatums.
- Abwechslungsreich ist auch dein Einsatz an den Kassen, wenn du das Team unterstützt.

## Anforderungen
- Bist du im Detailhandel ausgebildet (Grundbildung) oder hast du bereits viel Erfahrung im Verkauf gemacht? Bingo, dann bewirb dich.
- Deine Einsatzzeiten sind flexibel, aber das macht dir keine Probleme.
- Deutsch beherrschst du gut, und zwar im Gespräch und auf Papier.
- Vergünstigungen: Rabatt auf das Reiseangebot ITS Coop Travel, 5-fache Anzahl Superpunkte im Supermarkt, bis zu 20% Rabatt auf verschiedene Versicherungsleistungen, bis zu 20% Rabatt in allen Formaten der Coop-Gruppe, günstigere Mobile- und Prepaid-Abos bei Coop Mobile, Reka-Card: Vergünstigung bei Bezug, Vergünstigung bei Mobility CarSharing, Personalrabatt auch für Partner:in (im gleichen Haushalt lebend), Vergünstigung bei GA-Abonnement, Vergünstigungen bei Kulturanlässen, Vergünstigungen für Freizeitaktivitäten
- Anstellungsbedingungen: Pensionskasse: 2/3 wird von Coop einbezahlt, Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und zertifizierte Lohngleichheit, Treueprämien, Sparplan bei der Pensionskasse,Gesamtarbeitsvertrag (GAV), 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub und drei Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub
- Arbeitszeit: 5 Wochen Ferien, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle
- Weiterbildung: Über 600 interne Weiterbildungskurse, Talentmanagement mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, Aus- und Weiterbildungsangeboten des L-GAV und Coop
- Nachhaltigkeit: Engagement für Mensch, Tier und Natur mit über 400 Taten
- Kommunikation: interne App für Mitarbeitende
- Gesundheit: Update-Fitness: Fr. 200.– Rabatt aufs Jahresabonnement, Gratis Teilnahme an verschiedenen Firmenläufen, Firmeninterne Sportangebote
